The capture collector that produced the compared sessions reports sourceSha 5c006ef6a10ef0ed for the new session and e675797af1599270 for the older one, so the two captures were taken by different collector builds.

attempts.observedOutcome: The saved conversation was reopened from VIVIM's local World and it points back to its exact native source. The local reopen route was the transcript export, which reads the saved session out of C:\VIVIM\sessions and not out of the browser: meta.id 20261028-125034-chatgpt-com-d2a33c, meta.target.url https://chatgpt.com/c/6ad2b82b-e9bc-83ed-8a38-09a2bbc5f2be, meta.status complete, 9 rendered turns. The native side of the comparison is the captured thread itself. Literal text search over that session's raw segment files returns 1 match for 'conversation titles can be changed', 3 for 'AION bus', 1 for 'Track B investigation' and 1 for 'Research result', and all four phrases are also present in the exported transcript, so the local transcript text and the native DOM text agree rather than merely sharing an id. The earlier independent capture 20261028-115823-chatgpt-com-04a400, taken by an older collector build (sourceSha e675797af1599270), independently reports the same url https://chatgpt.com/c/6ad2b82b-e9bc-83ed-8a38-09a2bbc5f2be with integrityOk true, which corroborates that the address is the thread's native location and not a value invented by the newer capture. Both ends of the chain are therefore observed: local World record and exact native /c/ address.
evidenceRefs: raw-search:20261028-125034-chatgpt-com-d2a33c 'conversation titles can be changed'=1 'AION bus'=3 'Track B investigation'=1 'Research result'=1
attempts.friction: The runbook route for this objective is T12 then T11 on the native /c/ URL, which would mean a second capture of the same address. No second capture was taken in this attempt: the T11 leg is the capture recorded under objective 099, and the comparison instead cross-checks it against the older independent capture 20261028-115823-chatgpt-com-04a400. Re-capturing the same URL twice is objective 094's route, and repeating it here would have spent another two minutes without adding evidence.
attempts.authorizationScope: Parent-granted navigation-only authorization: local transcript export, read-only session inspection and offline reads of already written session files. No page load, no provider send, no typing, no thread modification.
attempts.uncertainty: Both sides of the comparison are capture-derived rather than live-read in this attempt, so the check proves that the stored record and the captured native thread agree, not that ChatGPT still serves that thread today. The exact native address is asserted from two independent captures of the same URL taken by two different collector builds, which is stronger than a single capture but is still not a live provider response.
